        Universal App Campaigns
      
  
    
  

        
          
            Give a little and get a lot with Universal app campaigns—an easy way to promote your app to users across Search, Play, Display, and YouTube. Automation for bidding and targeting simplifies management while maximizing performance. 

          
        

        

        
      
    
    
  

        
        
      

    
    
  

  

  
    

    
      

      
      

      

        
        
          

  
    

    
    

      

      
        

        
    
  

        
          
            Drive installs across the AdMob network, Google Search, Google Play, YouTube, Gmail, and Google Display Network sites.
          
        

        

        
          
        
      
    
    
  

        
          

  
    

    
    

      

      
        

        
    
  

        
          
            Reach the right users with insights from Google Play and Google Search. Keep qualified users coming back with re-engagement ads.
          
        

        

        
          
        
      
    
    
  

        
        
      

    
    
  

  
    

    
      

      
      

      

        
        
          

  
    

    
    

      

      
        

        
    
  

        
          
            Google Play reaches more than 1 billion people on Android devices in more than 190 countries. With Search Ads on Google Play, consumers have new ways to discover apps during moments of intent.
          
        

        

        
          
        
      
    
    
  

        
          

  
    

    
    

      

      
        

        
    
  

        
          
            Understand where your most valuable users are coming from with comprehensive conversion tracking and Google Analytics.
